Seminar Title:

Stochastic ordering results between two finite alpha-mixture models with resilience-scaled components

Seminar Type:

Abstract:

In this work, we consider two finite 𝛼-mixture models with resilience-scale distribution components, and then obtain sufficient conditions to establish some stochastic ordering results between them. The sufficient conditions mainly depend on the weak supermajorization, weak submajorization, chain majorization and reciprocal majorization orders. Examples are provided to illustrate the ordering outputs. In addition, some counterexamples are presented to show that the established results may not be true if the proposed conditions do not hold.
